name: grazer
brief: Grazer: a passive space jellyfish/manta hybrid about 3.2 m across that drifts in herds through the asteroid field grazing on rocks. It swims bell-first in slow pulses (+Y, the bell's apex, is the way it swims) and a crew member can stand on top of its bell and ride it. A smooth, pale bell with deep-teal markings radiating from the apex and a ring of cyan glowing spots near the rim; eight rim flaps the game curls in on each pulse; six tapering translucent teal feeding fronds of three segments each, with violet glowing tips, hanging from under the bell. Origin at the bell's centre (the physics body's centre: an ellipsoid of radii 1.6, 0.7, 1.6). Weak spot: a hot-magenta heart sac hanging in the bell's cavity, seen from below and from the side under the rim, hidden from above.
